title: fix(components): a half-typed between range shows itself as incomplete (objectui#10061)
body:
Fixes #10061

Clause-②: no — an accessibility diagnostic on an input this component already
accepts. No new exported prop, no new published key, no widening of any accepted set.

Ruling batch #146 item 5 letter A (objectstack#18012, maintainer 「146 同意」) declares a
`between` pair with one blank bound **incomplete: not emitted, AND shown as incomplete**.

## What was already true, measured before writing anything

The 「not emitted」 half has held since objectui#5025. Every write path reachable from this
builder folds the row through the builder's own arity-aware `isFilterValueComplete`, and
each one has its own pin — all five files below are green on this branch, unchanged:

| write path | what it feeds | its pin |
|---|---|---|
| `foldFilterGroupToSpecRules` (`app-shell/src/views/viewFilterFold.ts`) | saved / shared view rules, and metadata-admin's `FilterBuilderField`, which folds through it | `viewFilterFold.pairValue.test.ts`, `viewFilterFold.builderSetOperators.test.tsx` |
| `sanitizeViewOverride` (`app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`) | the personalization overlay | `ObjectView.overlayPairValue.test.ts` |
| `convertFilterGroupToAST` (`plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`) | the live grid query | `convertFilterGroupToAST.test.ts`, `convertFilterGroupToAST.canonicalSpelling.test.ts` |
| `groupToCondition` (`app-shell/.../inspectors/datasetFilterCondition.ts`) | a dataset's stored `filter` | `datasetFilterCondition.unmappedInert-9372.test.ts` |

The fourth is the dataset-filter bridge, which drops `between` **wholesale** — mapped by
nothing, inert by objectui#9372, and its own card. Firing control for that census: a tree
grep for the predicate also lands on `packages/fields`' `FilterConditionField`, which only
*mentions* it in prose while keeping a second rule of its own (objectui#9914, landed).

So the deliverable here is the other half only, and it was entirely unbuilt: the file
carried zero `aria-invalid` (control: four `aria-label` hits in the same file). An author
who typed one bound saw their value sitting on screen while every write path discarded the
whole row, with nothing anywhere saying so.

## What this adds

The blank bound of a half-filled pair now carries `aria-invalid`, an `aria-describedby`
description naming the missing side (「To is required」), and a destructive border — the
shadcn `Input` this file renders carries no `aria-invalid` styling of its own, so the
attribute alone would show a sighted author nothing.

⛔ A diagnostic, never a refusal. The completeness rule is untouched, `reshapeFilterValue`
and `toPairBounds` are untouched (the render-side padding is inert draft state and stays),
nothing gates on the marker — the only non-test reader of `aria-invalid` in this tree is a
CSS `has-[]` selector in `plugin-chatbot` — and the group's other rows keep applying.

**Only the asymmetric state is marked.** Both bounds blank is the untouched row `Add filter`
draws, and is no more half-written than an `equals` row with no value yet; both filled is a
complete range; a non-pair operator never renders it.

⚠️ **A blank bound is not a zero bound.** `isValueUnset`, never `!bound` (objectui#4873):
`[0, '']` is marked on its **upper** bound and `[0, 10]` is complete and marked nowhere. A
truthiness reading would mark the `0` the author had just typed and leave the blank side
clean — exactly backwards, and the way this fix goes wrong.

### Why `aria-invalid` and not a new spelling

Asked, not assumed. This tree has one structural spelling for 「the editor will not take
what is in this control」 — `aria-invalid`, pinned that way in `CelPredicateField`,
`ConditionWidget`, `ConditionalFormattingEditor` and `ConditionBuilder` — and no separate
「not finished yet」 idiom exists to use instead. `LocationField` is the precedent for a
widget computing its own, rather than receiving a host's error slot.

The one caveat found while checking: `celAuthoring.ts` ties `aria-invalid` to a severity the
save gates count, so the attribute reads as 「refused」 in that region. It is defensible here
because the gate half does not exist on this surface — nothing reads the attribute — and
because the marked value genuinely fails validation: objectstack#18012's spec half, merged,
now refuses `{$between: [1, '']}` at parse. Firing only on the **asymmetric** state is what
keeps it off the 「invalid while the user is still typing」 anti-pattern.

### i18n

No locale pack moves. The description reuses the shared `validation.required` key
(`{{field}} is required`, already in all ten packs) with the bound's own label filled into
the hole, mirrored verbatim in this file's `createSafeTranslation` defaults table exactly as
this package's `form.tsx` already mirrors that same row. Declaring a private
`filterBuilder.*` sentence would have been a new string for ten translators and a second
authority on the wording.

## Ablation — two legs, each discriminating

The two halves are pinned in two files on purpose, so a single mutation cannot red both and
prove neither. Both legs: anchor matched exactly once, the write verified on disk in both
directions, restore by `git checkout HEAD -- path` verified by blob hash.

- **Leg A — delete the marker** (`missingBound` forced to `null`): the new affordance file
  goes **7 failed**, `filter-builder-pair-completeness.test.tsx` stays green.
  `Test Files 1 failed | 1 passed (2)`.
- **Leg B — delete the completeness rule** (the pair arm back to the shape-blind length
  reading): `filter-builder-pair-completeness.test.tsx` goes **5 failed**, the new affordance
  file stays green. `Test Files 1 failed | 1 passed (2)`.

## Verification

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/` — `Test Files 169 passed`,
  `Tests 1656 passed` (run from the repo root, with the two `viewFilterFold` fold tests).
- The five write-path pins above, run together: `Test Files 5 passed`, `Tests 103 passed`.
- `packages/components`' own `type-check`, both legs: `tsc --noEmit` exit 0 and
  `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 0, after building the dependency closure
  (`pnpm --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build`) — without it `tsc` cannot resolve the
  workspace `.d.ts` and reports a prerequisite failure, not a type error.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys` · `check:i18n-drift` · `check:i18n-dead-keys` · `check:control-bytes`
  · `check:test-path-roots` · `check:changeset-claims` · `check:new-line-citations` ·
  `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` — all exit 0, each captured to a file and read
  back rather than judged through a pipe.
- Lint, narrowed to this package and declared: `eslint packages/components --format json`
  selected **501 files** by eslint's own config resolution and reported **0 errors** (962
  pre-existing warnings; this repo deliberately sets no `--max-warnings`). The narrowing is
  safe to state because no type-aware linting is configured — `eslint.config.js` declares no
  `projectService` and no `parserOptions.project` — so this diff cannot move the verdict on
  any file it did not touch. The repo-wide run is CI's.

All readings above are from the tree at `d31d17177`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Noted, not filed — `plugin-list`'s `UserFilters` is a second range surface with a
  different answer.** An authored `date-range` user filter lowers a half-filled pair to a
  **one-sided** query in `emitFilters` (only the bound that is filled becomes a `>=` or
  `<=`), so nothing is dropped and no `between` is emitted — a different mechanism, not this
  defect, and arguably correct on its own terms. What is left is an inconsistency between two
  surfaces: half-typing a range means 「open-ended」 in one and 「nothing yet」 in the other.
  Not a reproducible defect, no declared contract broken, no trap that makes an AI author
  refused metadata ⇒ outside the three filing classes. Carrier: none named — no open PR or
  queued card touches that file.
